title: Diablo II: Resurrected
provenance: Reported by JabesRUS (highball#371, 2026-10-17) for the Battle.net copy, Apple M5, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.15: on the default engine (x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26 and r27) with D3DMetal the game process sits idle after start and never opens a window; on the Wine 11 engine r23 Battle.net itself crashed (int3 in its embedded browser). Background, not measured here: Blizzard's January 2026 update tripped a Rosetta 2 deadlock that also hit Diablo IV and Overwatch 2 (Apple Developer Forums thread 814383, FB15880492 and FB21763885), and CodeWeavers reports Diablo IV and Overwatch running again on CrossOver 26.1 with macOS 26.5. Not verified by the maintainer. Swiss-Mac-User (highball#371, 2026-10-18), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.19: on the Wine 11 engine with D3DMetal and DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1, Battle.net crashed after login with repeated crash dialogs, so D2R could not be started there. AlexPako (highball#371, 2026-11-12), Apple M5 Pro 24 GB, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.26, the Steam copy (Infernal Edition, 2536520): on the default engine r28 with D3DMetal D2R.exe sits at about 0% CPU with no window, AVX advertised or not; on the Wine 11 engines r31 (D3DMetal 3) and r30 (D3DMetal 4 beta 3) it exits before a window with every sync and DLSS setting tried, and two direct runs outside the app ended on SIGILL. The same player (highball-db#1194, 2026-11-13), macOS 27.2.1, rated 3 of 5, playable with workarounds: it played on an engine they put together by hand, the Wine of the Wine 11 engine r4 (engine-wine-11.0-20260905T100545Z-cef60263) with r31's graphics and runtime parts and r31's nvapi stub, Windows 10, D3DMetal, AVX advertised, sync none, DLSS and frame generation off, plus HB_AUDIOBUF=0, CX_ACTIVE_GRAPHICS_BACKEND=d3dmetal, CX_APPLEGPTK_LIBD3DSHARED_PATH set to r31's libd3dshared.dylib and WINEDLLPATH_PREPEND set to r31's D3DMetal and DXMT folders (none shown to be needed one by one); with r9's Wine it hung instead. About 116 fps at 1920x1080 and 58.9 fps at 4K with 80% render scale and a 60 fps cap, in short tests. The cursor switched between the game's and the Mac's while the Metal performance HUD was on, and stopped with the HUD off.
notes: Direct3D 12, so D3DMetal. Doesn't start on any engine Highball ships in the reports so far: the Battle.net copy on the default engine and the Steam copy on the default engine and the Wine 11 engines r30 and r31 open no window (highball#371). One player got the Steam copy playing on an engine they put together by hand, the Wine of the Wine 11 engine r4 with r31's graphics parts (highball-db#1194), which points at a change in Wine after r4, not measured here. Highball doesn't offer that combination, the steps are in the known issues.

knownIssues.symptom: Never opens a window on the default engine, the game process idle (M5, macOS 27.0.1, the Battle.net copy; the Steam copy on an M5 Pro the same, highball#371)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. Blizzard games hit a Rosetta 2 deadlock from January 2026, and CodeWeavers reports Diablo IV and Overwatch running again with macOS 26.5 on CrossOver 26.1 and later
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed. The Wine 11 engines r30 and r31 don't start it either, see the next issue

knownIssues.symptom: On the Wine 11 engines r30 and r31 the Steam copy exits a few seconds after start, before any window (M5 Pro, highball#371). On the Wine 11 engine the Battle.net copy doesn't get that far, Battle.net crashed after login or never drew its window
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. Two direct runs outside the app ended on SIGILL. The Wine of the Wine 11 engine r4 with r31's graphics parts doesn't have it, and r9's Wine hangs instead (highball-db#1194)
knownIssues.fix: none built in. One player's hand made engine played it: a copy of r31 whose engine folder is replaced by r4's Wine, with r31's nvapi stub put back, Windows 10, D3DMetal, AVX advertised, sync none, DLSS and frame generation off, and the variables in the provenance (highball-db#1194). It means replacing an engine's files by hand

knownIssues.symptom: The cursor keeps switching between the game's cursor and the Mac pointer (M5 Pro, highball-db#1194)
knownIssues.cause: seen with the Metal performance HUD on
knownIssues.fix: turn the Metal performance HUD off in the environment's graphics settings and remove MTL_HUD_LOG_ENABLED if it was added, as the reporter did
